readings: For each media type (`Track.MediaTypeId`), show the media type ID, the average track unit price, and that average divided by a baseline equal to the simple average of the per-media-type average prices (each media type counted once). Don't round anything. Sort by the ratio from highest to lowest, with any missing ratios last, and show the top 10.
queries:
WITH media_averages AS (
    SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_price) AS baseline_price
    FROM media_averages
)
SELECT
    m.MediaTypeId,
    m.average_price,
    m.average_price / b.baseline_price AS ratio
FROM media_averages AS m
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
